title: oxytropis halleri subsp. velutina
intro: Oxytropis halleri subsp. velutina, commonly known as the Velvet Milkvetch, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. The Velvet Milkvetch is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Velvet Milkvetch include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
